summary: Median strip on a Moggill Road clearway; no place to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Strip sits between the carriageways of a busy arterial, with an apartment block 27 m away and commercial buildings beside it.
drivers.access_and_room: The line runs along a raised median or island between lanes; no room to pull fully out of the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Dual carriageway arterial with constant traffic.
drivers.convention: Clearway sign, Mon-Sat 7am-7pm, tow-away; the stretch is next to a clearway and has no parking lane.

flags: Slope data unreliable over 10 m (about 24% mean)
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees on the north side shade part of it in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the clearway lane is usable overnight
